test_title: PYST 08: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The walls of the marriage hall were __**covered by**__ beautiful purple curtains.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. covered with .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is "**with**."
 
• The phrase** "covered with"** is used to indicate that something is being used as a cover or is spread over an area.
 
• Options 2, 3, and 4, "covered upon," "covered of," and "covered on" are not appropriate prepositions to use with "covered" in this context.

Correct sentence: *The walls of the marriage hall were covered with beautiful purple curtains*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using the correct preposition is essential for conveying the accurate meaning of a sentence.
 
• “Covered with” is commonly used to describe something that is coated or overlaid with a particular substance or material.
